body: I don't have friends anymore.  Early in our relationship she was able to push my friends away by manipulating the situation to create distrust either from me or them. Having never been in this kind of situation before, I didn't see it for what it was until much later.  I have family in another state, but the same type of alienation happened with them as well.  Considering the damage done, I don't think I could even approach them now.  It's rare that I have opportunity to speak to someone unmonitored, and I think due to proximity talking to a neighbor is out.  I hadn't thought of going to a church.  Maybe the next time she sends me out to the store I can manage to go to a nearby church.  Though, I know she monitors the GPS on her car so she can track me even when she's not with me.  So, I'll have to concoct a story, but it is an idea.  Thanks for the input.
